title: Audit local climate extremes and complete observation lineage

acceptance.text: Verify selected raw extrema, spatial and district impact, neighbours, derived lineage and temperature consistency without refreshing observations.
acceptance.evidence: Audited 14 observations covering seven padded-area and seven district-used extrema. All selected normalized/monthly/chart/replay/district lineages match raw values and provenance; all 100 raw responses passed request/checksum/structure checks, and 1,278,340 matched temperature triplets have no ordering violations. The 965.18 mm/day location is outside pinned Bangladesh geometry and unused by district exports; the district-used rainfall maximum is 521.24 mm/day.

acceptance.text: Publish reproducible audit evidence, distinguish source questions from proven processing errors, and run relevant checks without claiming review acceptance.
acceptance.evidence: Created reproducible offline audit code, five synthetic method tests, Markdown report and small JSON evidence file. All 14 selected values are category B; no processing error was proved, while physical accuracy and the outside-country Chapainawabganj representative point remain category C questions. All 95 repository tests and 25 focused tests passed; no climate data, mapping, frontend or crop rule was modified.
